title: Console wrap: 32px top padding applied to 12 stage frames
summary: Applied paddingTop = 32 (Spacing / 2xl, VariableID:1:25) to the Console wrap layer in all 12 stage frames that had top padding of 0, giving the Console chrome band the cream breathing room the Chairman requested. Stages 07b, 08b, 08c also received right/bottom/left = 32 (all four sides were 0, a secondary inconsistency). Stage 01's Console wrap was already at 32px top but had raw pixel values on all sides — variable binding applied retroactively.

artifact.wrapElement: Console wrap (FRAME) — the cream/paper container that holds Console inner + chrome band; immediate child of each stage frame
artifact.rationale: paddingTop = 0 caused the dark Console chrome band to sit flush against the top of the cream Console wrap interior. Adding 32px top padding creates the cream gap between the wrap edge and the chrome band. Stage 01 (4:608) was the reference — already at 32px, visually correct.

stage01Retrofix.note: paddingTop was already 32px (correct), but all four sides had raw pixel values with no variable binding. Variable binding applied retroactively for token discipline.

artifact.brandPageReason: Brand page frames (1:290, 1:396, 1:510) use a different architecture — Console chrome (stubbed) + Console viewport, no dark outer wrap. The Chairman's instruction specifically targets the dark-surround pattern. Brand page frames are out of scope.

tokenBinding.method: setBoundVariable('paddingTop', variable) — no raw pixel values set

sideEffects: No wrap required re-growing. Console wraps use HUG vertical sizing — adding paddingTop expands the wrap height naturally without overflow. No clipping observed in post-fix screenshots.
tokenGaps: None. Spacing / 2xl (32) was already in the catalogue.
accessibilityNote: No contrast pairs changed. AAA standing objective not applicable to this spacing change.
